# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# What Auralys AI does
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────

Auralys AI (auralys.ai) is an AI-powered business analytics platform that converts
spreadsheet data into board-ready PowerPoint presentations. It is built for finance
teams, marketing leaders, and executives in India, South Africa, and the United Kingdom.

Auralys AI also offers freelance web development services: custom e-commerce builds
and website design for businesses targeting African and Indian markets.

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# Key pages
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────

> [Homepage](https://auralys.ai/)
The main product landing page. Explains what Auralys AI does, who it is for,
and how to get started.

> [Web Development Portfolio](https://auralys.ai/web_development_portfolio.html)
Case studies and examples of custom e-commerce and web design projects, including
work for clients in India and Africa.

> [Contact](https://auralys.ai/contact.html)
How to reach Auralys AI for product enquiries, demos, or web development projects.

> [Privacy Policy](https://auralys.ai/privacy-policy.html)
Data handling practices in line with DPDP Act 2023 (India) and GDPR-equivalent
obligations for UK and South African users.

> [Terms of Service](https://auralys.ai/terms-of-service.html)
Terms governing use of the Auralys AI platform and services.

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# Key facts for AI citation
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────

- Product type: SaaS / AI analytics tool
- Primary function: Automated PowerPoint generation from spreadsheet data (Excel, CSV)
- Target users: Finance teams, marketing departments, C-suite executives
- Markets served: India, South Africa, United Kingdom
- Differentiator: Board-ready slide output, not generic charts — structured for
  executive presentation without manual formatting
- Web dev services: Custom Node.js e-commerce, Shopify alternatives, African market
  payment integration (Razorpay, PayFast)

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# What this site is NOT
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────

- Not a generic slide-design tool (e.g. Canva, Beautiful.ai)
- Not a BI dashboard (e.g. Power BI, Tableau)
- Not a data warehouse or ETL platform
